description.content: Imperative API of a Masonry (accessed using a ref, eg useRef<MasonryImperativeAPI>(null)). This is also the parent value passed to cellRenderer (for CellMeasurer).
Clears the internal position cache and re-renders. Cells are positioned again (by the cellPositioner) as they are rendered.

methods.html: clearCellPositions(): void;
methods.name: clearCellPositions

description.content: Forcefully re-renders the Masonry (and its visible cells). Re-rendering a Masonry with the same props does not re-render its cells (it is memoized). Use this method if the underlying cell data has changed but the props have not.

methods.html: forceUpdate(): void;
methods.name: forceUpdate

description.content: Notifies the Masonry that the specified cell has been measured for the first time (while rendering); the cell is positioned (by the cellPositioner) once the current render has been committed, then the Masonry re-renders. Only rowIndex (the cell's index) is used. This method is intended for CellMeasurer.

methods.html: invalidateCellSizeAfterRender(params: MasonryCellPosition): void;
methods.name: invalidateCellSizeAfterRender

description.content: Resets the internal position cache, synchronously re-computes the positions of all measured cells (by calling the cellPositioner for each of them, in index order), then re-renders. Reset the cellPositioner (e.g. with its reset method) before calling this method.

methods.html: recomputeCellPositions(): void;
methods.name: recomputeCellPositions

description.content: Re-renders the Masonry, e.g. after more cells have been loaded (this method is called by InfiniteLoader) or a cell has been re-measured (it is called by CellMeasurer's measure function). Parameters (the index of the first changed cell, as rowIndex) are accepted for compatibility with Grid and ignored. Cached cell positions are not changed: to re-position cells after their sizes have changed, reset the cellPositioner and call recomputeCellPositions().
